body.answer: According to CDC Standard Precautions, healthcare workers must perform hand hygiene before and after patient contact using soap and water or alcohol-based hand rubs. This is a critical infection prevention measure.

citations.title: CDC Standard Precautions for All Patient Care
citations.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

retrieved_chunks: Hand hygiene is the single most important measure to reduce healthcare-associated infections. Healthcare workers should perform hand hygiene before and after patient contact using soap and water or alcohol-based hand rubs as per CDC Standard Precautions.
